Name: Train Graffiti Replacer
Author: Geminia
Description:
[b][size=5]Train Graffiti Replacer
[/size][/b]
Would you like to add your own tag to Stardew Valley?  Look no further!  This mod replaces one of the graffiti images on the trains with one of the player's choice.

There's a default graffiti tag of a smirking blood moon named Bob, but if you don't like the image, feel free to swap it out with one of your own!  There's a blank template called "PlayerImage.png" that has the correct dimensions that you can use to create your own tag.  You're also able to choose which existing graffiti image is replaced.



[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿. Unpack and place the "[CP] Train Graffiti Replacer" folder into your Mods folder. 



[size=4][b]Config Options[/b][/size]

To configure the options of this mod, open the "config.json" file from the mod folder with a text editor on your computer.  If this is your first time using the mod, you will need to run Stardew Valley first before the "config.json" file will appear in the mod folder.  If you delete, rename, or corrupt the "config.json" file, it will be recreated automatically the next time the game launches, with default options selected.

A full list of the config options has been included in the "ConfigInstructions.txt" file in the mod folder. However, they are also posted below for your convenience.

[b]Selectable Options[/b]        

ModActive: Off, On
﻿Off: Normal game mechanics
﻿On: Mod alterations apply

ImageType: BobMoon, PlayerImage
﻿BobMoon: Changes train graffiti to BloodMoon
﻿PlayerImage: Changes train graffiti to one of the player's creation

VanillaImageReplaced: Image1, Image2, Image3, Image4, Image5, Image6, Image7, Image8, Image9, Image10, Image11, Image12, Image13, Image 14, Image15, Image16, Image17, Image18, Image19, Image20, Image21, Image22, Image23, Image24, Image25, Image26, Image27, Image28, Image29
﻿Image#: Changes image to selection in Image Selection, look at ImagePreview to see which one you're replacing.
